transcript.text: Hello, I'm here to help you get ready for your appointment. Could you tell me what has been bothering you?
Well, I've been having trouble going to the toilet — opening my bowels much less often, and I have to strain a lot.
When did you first notice you were having trouble going to the toilet?
It's been going on for a while now, I'm not quite sure exactly.
Do you have any allergies, or has any medicine ever given you a bad reaction?
No, I don't think so — I've never had a bad reaction to any medicine.
How much is this affecting your day-to-day life?
It's not too bad, but it does make me feel uncomfortable and a bit bloated in my tummy.
Are you taking any medicines at the moment — either ones you take regularly, or anything new or changed recently?
Yes, I take a few tablets — some for my heart, and some painkillers for my back.
Have you ever had any operations or stayed in hospital for anything?
No, I don't think I've ever had an operation or stayed in hospital.
How bad would you say the trouble going to the toilet is — mild, moderate, or severe, or are you not sure?
It's uncomfortable, I'd say somewhere in the middle — not terrible, but not nothing either.
Where do you feel this discomfort the most, and does it stay in one place or spread anywhere else?
It's mostly in my lower tummy, and it just stays there.
Have you noticed anything you eat or drink that seems to make it better or worse?
I'm not really sure. I have been drinking less than I used to, I suppose.
You mentioned feeling a bit bloated in your tummy — is there anything else you've noticed going on with your body that we haven't talked about yet?
No, nothing else really — no blood or anything like that, and I haven't been sick.
What worries you most about the trouble you're having going to the toilet?
I'd just like something to get things moving again, really. And I suppose I do worry a bit that it could be something serious.
Is there anything else from your past health — like other illnesses or ongoing conditions — that you think I should know about?
I have arthritis in my back and knees, and I've got an irregular heartbeat — the doctor told me about that some time ago.
Is there anything else about your health from the past — any other conditions or illnesses — that we haven't talked about yet?
No, that's all I can think of — just the arthritis and the irregular heartbeat.
Are you taking any medicines at the moment — ones you take regularly, any that have been started or changed recently, or are you not sure?
Well, I take a couple of tablets for my heart, and I was started on some strong painkillers for my back about a month ago — co-codamol, the doctor gave me those.
Thank you, that is very helpful. I have put together a short summary of what you told me. Please read it and tell me if anything should be corrected before it goes to your doctor.
